User.title: User
User.description: Root user account storing overall step statistics, streak, and preferences.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

activeProfileId.description: ID of the currently active walking mode profile.

lifetimeXp.description: Total XP earned across all walks.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when user document was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when user document was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Walking mode configuration and banked screen time vault balance.

dailySteps.description: Steps walked today in this mode.

bankedSeconds.description: Banked screen time seconds available for Instagram.

stepsPerMinute.description: Steps required to unlock one minute of screen time.

dailyStepGoal.description: Daily step target for this mode.

bonusMinutes.description: Bonus screen time minutes granted upon reaching the goal.

DayHistory.title: DayHistory
DayHistory.description: Daily step count and screen time usage record.

steps.description: Total steps completed on this day.

earnedMinutes.description: Total minutes unlocked via steps on this day.

spentMinutes.description: Total minutes spent on Instagram on this day.

goalReached.description: Whether the daily step goal was met.

/users/{userId}.description: User account document containing global step statistics.

/users/{userId}/profiles/{profileId}.description: Profiles / modes configured for this user.

/users/{userId}/history/{dateIso}.description: Daily historical activity records for weekly trend analytics.
